```python
clean = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "sensor": ["AQ-04", "AQ-03", "AQ-03", "AQ-04", "AQ-03", "AQ-01", "AQ-01", "AQ-01", "AQ-04"],
        "room": ["Music room", "Science lab", "Science lab", "Music room", "Science lab",
                 "Room 1", "Room 1", "Room 1", "Music room"],
        "time": pd.to_datetime(["2026-03-06 09:00", "2026-03-06 09:00", "2026-03-06 09:30", "2026-03-05 10:00",
                                "2026-03-05 09:00", "2026-03-05 09:00", "2026-03-05 09:30", "2026-03-05 10:00",
                                "2026-03-06 09:30"]),
        "co2_ppm": np.array([1499, 1500, 1720, 1100, 900, 700, 701, 701, 1720], dtype="int64"),
        "temp_c": [np.nan, 20.04, 20.0, 21.0, 19.0, 20.0, np.nan, 21.0, np.nan],
    }
)
daily = summarise(clean)
check_frame(
    daily,
    pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "date": pd.to_datetime(["2026-03-05", "2026-03-05", "2026-03-05", "2026-03-06", "2026-03-06"]),
            "room": ["Music room", "Room 1", "Science lab", "Music room", "Science lab"],
            "readings": np.array([1, 3, 1, 2, 2], dtype="int64"),
            "mean_co2": [1100.0, 700.7, 900.0, 1609.5, 1610.0],
            "max_co2": np.array([1100, 701, 900, 1720, 1720], dtype="int64"),
            "high": np.array([0, 0, 0, 1, 2], dtype="int64"),
            "mean_temp": [21.0, 20.5, 19.0, np.nan, 20.0],
        }
    ),
    "summarise: one row per day and room, sorted, with rounded means, 1500 ppm counted as high, "
    "and NaN when a room has no temperature that day",
)

empty_quarantine = pd.DataFrame(
    {column: pd.Series([], dtype="str") for column in ["file", "sensor", "time", "co2_ppm", "temp_c", "reason"]}
).assign(line=pd.Series([], dtype="int64"))[["file", "line", "sensor", "time", "co2_ppm", "temp_c", "reason"]]
text = report(clean, empty_quarantine, daily)
assert text == (
    "Air quality report\n"
    "Rows read: 9\n"
    "Rows kept: 9 (100.0%)\n"
    "Rows quarantined: 0\n"
    "Worst room each day:\n"
    "  2026-03-05 Music room: max 1100 ppm, 0 of 1 readings high\n"
    "  2026-03-06 Music room: max 1720 ppm, 1 of 2 readings high\n"
), "report with nothing quarantined has no reason lines, and a tie for the worst room goes to the first room by name"

quarantine = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "file": ["x.csv"] * 4,
        "line": [2, 5, 7, 9],
        "sensor": ["AQ-01", "AQ-02", "AQ-01", "AQ-01"],
        "time": ["", "2026-03-05 09:00", "2026-03-05 09:00", "2026-03-05 09:00"],
        "co2_ppm": ["700", "n/a", "700", "700"],
        "temp_c": ["20.0", "20.0", "20.0", "99"],
        "reason": ["bad time", "bad co2", "duplicate", "bad temperature"],
    }
)
lines = report(clean.iloc[:2], quarantine, summarise(clean.iloc[:2])).splitlines()
assert lines[1:8] == [
    "Rows read: 6",
    "Rows kept: 2 (33.3%)",
    "Rows quarantined: 4",
    "  bad co2: 1",
    "  bad temperature: 1",
    "  bad time: 1",
    "  duplicate: 1",
], "report counts rows read, kept (with a one-decimal percentage) and quarantined, with reasons in alphabetical order"
assert lines[8:] == ["Worst room each day:", "  2026-03-06 Science lab: max 1500 ppm, 1 of 1 readings high"], (
    "report lists only the days that are in the summary"
)
```

**Test 4: Writes Parquet, CSV and report files and exits with the right status** (hidden)

```python
# The program: the files it writes, what it prints, and its exit status when the input is bad.
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

FILES = ["data/readings-2026-03-02.csv", "data/readings-2026-03-03.csv"]
EXPECTED_REPORT = """Air quality report
Rows read: 134
Rows kept: 122 (91.0%)
Rows quarantined: 12
  bad co2: 3
  bad temperature: 2
  bad time: 2
  duplicate: 3
  unknown sensor: 2
Worst room each day:
  2026-03-02 Music room: max 1866 ppm, 4 of 12 readings high
  2026-03-03 Science lab: max 1934 ppm, 5 of 12 readings high
"""

ran = run_script(args=[*FILES, "--out", "results/march"])
assert ran.code == 0, f"the program exits with status 0 on good input, not {ran.code}"
assert ran.out == EXPECTED_REPORT, "standard output carries the report and nothing else"
assert "Traceback" not in ran.err, "a successful run prints no traceback"
assert "INFO: " in ran.err, "the program logs its steps at INFO level to standard error"

out = Path("results/march")
for name in ["readings.parquet", "daily.parquet", "quarantine.csv", "report.txt"]:
    assert (out / name).is_file(), f"the program writes {name} into the --out folder, creating it when needed"
assert (out / "report.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == EXPECTED_REPORT, "report.txt holds the report"

rooms = pd.read_csv("data/rooms.csv", dtype=str)
clean, quarantine = validate(load_readings(FILES), rooms)
check_frame(
    pd.read_parquet(out / "readings.parquet"),
    clean,
    "readings.parquet reads back as the clean frame, with the same columns, dtypes and a plain index",
)
check_frame(
    pd.read_parquet(out / "daily.parquet"),
    summarise(clean),
    "daily.parquet reads back as the daily summary, with the same columns, dtypes and a plain index",
)
check_frame(
    pd.read_csv(out / "quarantine.csv", dtype=str, keep_default_na=False),
    quarantine.astype({"line": "str"}),
    "quarantine.csv holds the quarantined rows and their reasons, without the index",
)

ran = run_script(args=["data/readings-broken.csv", "--out", "broken-out"])
assert ran.code == 1, f"a file without the required columns exits with status 1, not {ran.code}"
assert ran.out == "", "a failed run prints nothing on standard output"
assert "ERROR: " in ran.err and "Traceback" not in ran.err, "a failed run logs an ERROR line, not a traceback"
assert not Path("broken-out").exists() or not any(Path("broken-out").iterdir()), "a failed run writes no files"

for args, what in [
    (["data/no-such-file.csv", "--out", "missing-out"], "a reading file that does not exist"),
    (["data/readings-2026-03-02.csv", "--rooms", "data/no-rooms.csv", "--out", "missing-out"],
     "a rooms file that does not exist"),
    (["data/readings-empty.csv", "--out", "missing-out"], "a file with no valid readings"),
]:
    status = main(args)
    assert status == 1, f"main returns 1 for {what}, not {status!r}"
    assert not Path("missing-out").exists() or not any(Path("missing-out").iterdir()), (
        f"nothing is written for {what}"
    )

try:
    main([])
except SystemExit as stop:
    assert stop.code == 2, f"running without a FILE is a usage error with status 2, not {stop.code!r}"
else:
    raise AssertionError("running without a FILE is a usage error: argparse exits with status 2")
```

**Test 5: Handles another column layout, file order and empty files** (hidden)

```python
# A file with another column order and an extra column, an empty file, and the order of the files.
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

rooms = pd.read_csv("data/rooms.csv", dtype=str)

raw = load_readings(["data/readings-2026-03-04.csv"])
assert list(raw.columns) == ["file", "line", "sensor", "time", "co2_ppm", "temp_c"], (
    "load_readings returns the stated columns whatever their order in the file, and drops other columns"
)
assert len(raw) == 28 and raw.loc[7, "sensor"] == "aq-05 ", "load_readings reads every line of the file as written"

clean, quarantine = validate(raw, rooms)
assert quarantine["line"].tolist() == [10, 18], "the 2026-03-04 file has two quarantined rows"
assert quarantine["reason"].tolist() == ["bad co2", "bad co2"], "a co2 of 850.5 or an empty co2 is a bad co2"
assert len(clean) == 26 and "AQ-05" in set(clean["sensor"]), "a sensor id with spaces and lower case is cleaned"

daily = summarise(clean)
check_frame(
    daily,
    pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "date": pd.to_datetime(["2026-03-04"] * 4),
            "room": ["Hall", "Music room", "Room 2", "Science lab"],
            "readings": np.array([7, 7, 5, 7], dtype="int64"),
            "mean_co2": [688.7, 1092.3, 836.6, 1108.3],
            "max_co2": np.array([878, 1650, 1233, 1650], dtype="int64"),
            "high": np.array([0, 1, 0, 1], dtype="int64"),
            "mean_temp": [20.4, 20.2, 19.8, 20.2],
        }
    ),
    "the daily summary of the 2026-03-04 file, where a room with no readings does not appear",
)
assert report(clean, quarantine, daily).splitlines()[-1] == (
    "  2026-03-04 Music room: max 1650 ppm, 1 of 7 readings high"
), "when two rooms share the highest max_co2 of a day, the first by name is the worst room"

# Files are read in the order given, so the reading sent twice is kept from the file read first.
FILES = ["data/readings-2026-03-03.csv", "data/readings-2026-03-02.csv"]
clean, quarantine = validate(load_readings(FILES), rooms)
duplicates = quarantine[quarantine["reason"] == "duplicate"][["file", "line"]].reset_index(drop=True)
check_frame(
    duplicates,
    pd.DataFrame({"file": ["readings-2026-03-02.csv"] * 3, "line": [57, 64, 69]}),
    "duplicates are found in the order the files are given, keeping the first one read",
)
assert len(clean) == 122, "the order of the files does not change how many rows are kept"

empty = load_readings(["data/readings-empty.csv"])
assert len(empty) == 0, "a file with only a header gives no rows"
assert list(empty.columns) == ["file", "line", "sensor", "time", "co2_ppm", "temp_c"], (
    "a file with only a header still gives the six columns"
)
clean, quarantine = validate(empty, rooms)
assert len(clean) == 0 and list(clean.columns) == ["sensor", "room", "time", "co2_ppm", "temp_c"], (
    "validate of no rows gives a clean frame with no rows and the stated columns"
)
assert len(quarantine) == 0 and list(quarantine.columns) == [
    "file", "line", "sensor", "time", "co2_ppm", "temp_c", "reason"
], "validate of no rows gives a quarantine frame with no rows and the stated columns"
daily = summarise(clean)
assert len(daily) == 0 and list(daily.columns) == [
    "date", "room", "readings", "mean_co2", "max_co2", "high", "mean_temp"
], "summarise of no rows gives no rows and the stated columns"

three = load_readings(["data/readings-2026-03-02.csv", "data/readings-empty.csv", "data/readings-2026-03-04.csv"])
assert len(three) == 96, "an empty file among others adds no rows"
clean, quarantine = validate(three, rooms)
lines = report(clean, quarantine, summarise(clean)).splitlines()
assert lines[1:3] == ["Rows read: 96", "Rows kept: 87 (90.6%)"], "report counts the rows of every file"
assert lines[-2:] == [
    "  2026-03-02 Music room: max 1866 ppm, 4 of 12 readings high",
    "  2026-03-04 Music room: max 1650 ppm, 1 of 7 readings high",
], "report has one worst-room line per day in date order"
```
